response.sql: WITH site_processing AS (SELECT sp.zoneref, s.entrystat, AVG(sp.memusagegb) as site_avg_ram, AVG(1.0 * sp.procgpu / NULLIF(sp.proccpu, 0)) as site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM scanprocessing sp INNER JOIN sites s ON sp.zoneref = s.zoneregistry WHERE sp.memusagegb >= 60.8 GROUP BY sp.zoneref, s.entrystat) SELECT entrystat, AVG(site_avg_ram) as avg_ram_usage, AVG(site_avg_gpu_cpu_ratio) as avg_gpu_cpu_ratio FROM site_processing GROUP BY entrystat ORDER BY entrystat

assumptions.assumption: "using 60.8 GB of RAM as the cutoff" means memusagegb >= 60.8 (inclusive). Could alternatively be interpreted as > 60.8.

alternatives.interpretation: If cutoff should exclude exactly 60.8, use strict inequality WHERE sp.memusagegb > 60.8
